_how_to_use: Copy to <data folder>/profile.json and fill in. build_tracker.py reads buyer_type, home_currency and overrides; the rest guides the analysis. Anything marked ASSUMED has not been confirmed by the buyer yet — say so in every report until it is.
buyer_type_status: CONFIRMED by the buyer on 2026-11-20: foreign national. That they live outside Morocco is still ASSUMED.
tax_residence_status: CONFIRMED by the buyer on 2026-11-20: UK income-tax band 40%.
_safe_return_at_home: What the same cash earns risk-free at home, as a fraction (0.04 = 4%). The yield a purchase has to beat.
_overrides_note: home_tax_rate: confirmed by the buyer (UK 40% band); home_cgt_rate 24% follows from that band. rate_foreign_non_resident 4.53%: the buyer asked for today's fixed home-loan rate — Bank Al-Maghrib's latest published average for new housing loans (Q2 2026; before the 10% VAT on interest; whether foreigners pay more is unverified). term_years 25 and ltv 70%: the video's terms for a foreign buyer (30% deposit, up to 25 years); Banque Populaire publishes 70% over 25 years, CIH 70% over 15, Bank of Africa 50%.
financing_status: CONFIRMED by the buyer on 2026-11-20: expects to buy with a Moroccan mortgage.
strategy_status: CONFIRMED by the buyer on 2026-11-20: rental income, particularly Airbnb, as in the video.
playbook: Buyer's instruction, 2026-11-20: follow the video's playbook exactly. Lead every analysis with the video's own 'analyse the deal' calculation (the ★ section), using a fixed rate at today's market level. Show the checked version beside it.
max_monthly_topup_note: Buyer, 21 Nov 2026: happy to pay about £400 a month out of pocket if the flat is theirs at the end of the loan; the figure is indicative, "plus minus 20%", so up to about £480 is acceptable. Do not call a deal a pass just because it runs at a monthly loss; test it against this range and check the Airbnb case is robust.
